coverage: Three supported owner/reopen/uncertain repairs in one real store patch; text and IDs preserved.
Keep-all semantic state preservation and explicit no-change version increment.
Insufficient evidence and unsupported compound transitions hold whole records.
Missing/duplicate/unknown record coverage, strict JSON, extra text writes, source validation and verdict/value conflicts rejected.
Stale version or observation rejected without audit mutation.
Injected runtime failure after a legal first operation rolls back atomically.
All existing IDs including withdrawn are in annotation-free prompt; no silent truncation.
Generator callback called once; malformed output and generation failure do not retry.
limitations: These tests use scripted reports and callbacks; they do not establish that the tracker produces correct audit reports.
Coverage and arrived user citations are structural checks, not semantic sufficiency judgments.
Existing-record audit does not recover missing intentions or rewrite text.
Accepted held-only/no-change reports increment store version; no semantic field changes are claimed for them.
